SepaMandate.title: SEPA Mandate
SepaMandate.description: A SEPA Direct Debit mandate (incassomachtiging) authorising the creditor to collect from a debtor account under the SDD CORE or B2B rulebook. Source of truth for incasso eligibility; collections may only be scheduled against an `active` mandate (design D1).

mandateReference.description: Unique mandate reference per creditor, max 35 chars, immutable once issued. Operator-supplied; never auto-generated.
mandateReference.title: Mandate Reference

creditorIdentifier.description: Dutch creditor identifier NL{check}ZZZ{KvK} per De Nederlandsche Bank.
creditorIdentifier.title: Creditor Identifier

scheme.description: SDD rulebook scheme: CORE (consumer debtors) or B2B (business debtors).
scheme.title: Scheme

type.description: recurring (RCUR-capable) or oneoff (OOFF, single collection only).
type.title: Type

status.description: Mandate lifecycle status. Managed by x-openregister-lifecycle.
status.title: Status

signedAt.description: Date the mandate was signed by the debtor. Must not be after a collection's requestedCollectionDate.
signedAt.title: Signed At

signedBy.description: Debtor name as it appears on the mandate document.
signedBy.title: Signed By

debtorIban.description: Debtor bank account IBAN; validated mod-97 at batch generation.
debtorIban.title: Debtor IBAN

debtorBic.description: BIC/SWIFT; mandatory for non-EEA destinations, optional for EEA.
debtorBic.title: Debtor BIC

debtorAccountType.description: consumer (CORE only) or business (B2B only). Mismatch with scheme is rejected sdd.mandate.scheme.mismatch.
debtorAccountType.title: Debtor Account Type

lastCollectionDate.description: Last known or planned collection date.
lastCollectionDate.title: Last Collection Date

lastUsedAt.description: Date of last successful collection; drives the 36-month dormancy expiry rule.
lastUsedAt.title: Last Used At

mandateDocument.description: OpenRegister file reference to the scanned signature or digital-signing evidence (PDF/image). Stored per OR files-attached-to-object pattern.
mandateDocument.title: Mandate Document

cancellationReason.description: Free-text reason recorded when status transitions to cancelled.
cancellationReason.title: Cancellation Reason

preNotificationDays.description: Lead time in calendar days for pre-notification; default 14 per SDD CORE rulebook 2.6, configurable down to contractual minimum.
preNotificationDays.title: Pre Notification Days

reviewFlag.description: Set true when a consumer refund (MD06) is received; high refund rate risks scheme exclusion.
reviewFlag.title: Review Flag

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-001).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Awaiting signature/activation. No collections may be scheduled (design D1).

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. No further collections may reference this mandate. cancellationReason recorded.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Terminal. Auto-set after 36 months of inactivity. Requires a fresh mandate.

activate.label: Activate mandate
activate.description: Operator activates a signed mandate, making it eligible for collections.

cancel.label: Cancel mandate
cancel.description: Operator cancels the mandate with a recorded cancellationReason. Future-dated scheduled collections are cancelled automatically.

suspend.label: Suspend mandate
suspend.description: Temporarily block the mandate from new collections.

resume.label: Resume mandate
resume.description: Re-enable a suspended mandate for collections.

expire.label: Expire (dormancy)
expire.description: Automated transition after 36 months of inactivity, driven by the daily MandateDormancyExpiryJob.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a SEPA Mandate is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

DirectDebitCollection.title: Direct Debit Collection
DirectDebitCollection.description: A single SEPA Direct Debit collection against a mandate. sequenceType is derived from mandate history, never operator-supplied (design D2).

invoiceId.description: FK to Invoice UUID (nullable for ad-hoc collections).
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

amount.description: Collection amount in EUR, two decimals.
amount.title: Amount

sequenceType.description: Auto-derived from mandate history; operator input is rejected (REQ-SDD-002, design D2). FRST=first, RCUR=recurrent, OOFF=one-off, FNAL=final.
sequenceType.title: Sequence Type

requestedCollectionDate.description: Date funds should hit the creditor account.
requestedCollectionDate.title: Requested Collection Date

endToEndId.description: Unique end-to-end identifier per creditor, max 35 chars.
endToEndId.title: End To End ID

pain002ReasonCode.description: ISO 20022 reason code if rejected, e.g. AM04, AC04, MD01.
pain002ReasonCode.title: Pain002Reason Code

camt054ReferenceId.description: Reference ID from the camt.054 notification that closed this collection.
camt054ReferenceId.title: Camt054Reference ID

repostedAsCollectionId.description: FK to the new collection created when this one was reposted.
repostedAsCollectionId.title: Reposted As Collection ID

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-002).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

scheduled.label: Scheduled
scheduled.description: Created and awaiting inclusion in a pain.008 batch.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Included in a batch submitted to the bank.

presented.label: Presented
presented.description: Presented for debit at the debtor bank.

succeeded.label: Succeeded
succeeded.description: camt.054 debit confirmed; invoice paid, journal posted.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: pain.002 RJCT with a reason code. Repostable only for bank-problem codes.

refunded.label: Refunded
refunded.description: camt.054 return/refund; journal reversed, receivable re-opened.

submit.label: Submit in batch
submit.description: Batch generation includes this collection; gated by pre-notification and submission-window guards.

reject.label: Rejected (pain.002)
reject.description: pain.002 RJCT ingestion with reason code.

refund.label: Refunded (camt.054 R-transaction)
refund.description: camt.054 return/refund; creates an RTransaction record.

repost.label: Repost
repost.description: One-click repost; allowed only for bank-problem reason codes.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Direct Debit Collection is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

DirectDebitBatch.title: Direct Debit Batch
DirectDebitBatch.description: A pain.008.001.02 batch aggregating homo-sequence collections for submission. pain008Xml / pain002Xml are archived 7+ years (bewaarplicht, design D11).

messageId.description: Globally unique message id per creditor per file, max 35 chars.
messageId.title: Message ID

requestedCollectionDate.description: Earliest collection date in the batch.
requestedCollectionDate.title: Requested Collection Date

collectionCount.description: Number of collections in the batch; equals pain.008 NbOfTxs.
collectionCount.title: Collection Count

controlSum.description: Sum of all collection amounts in EUR; equals pain.008 CtrlSum.
controlSum.title: Control Sum

pain008Xml.description: Full ISO 20022 pain.008.001.02 payload; archived 7+ years, non-deletable.
pain008Xml.title: Pain008Xml

submittedAt.description: When the batch was submitted to the bank via connector.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

isArchived.description: Retention flag; archived pain files must not be auto-deleted (REQ-SDD-010, design D11).
isArchived.title: Is Archived

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: pain.008 generated and XSD-validated; eligible for submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Sent to the bank via connector.

fully_rejected.label: Fully rejected
fully_rejected.description: pain.002 RJCT for the whole group.

generate.label: Generate pain.008
generate.description: Generate and XSD-validate the pain.008 payload; gated by pre-notification and submission-window preconditions.

submit.label: Submit to bank
submit.description: Hand the batch to the bank connector.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Direct Debit Batch is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

RTransaction.title: R-Transaction
RTransaction.description: A bank-side R-transaction (reject/return/refund/reversal/revocation) parsed from pain.002 or camt.054. Captured separately for audit and reposting decisions (design D7). Non-deletable.

reasonCode.description: ISO 20022 ExternalReturnReason code, e.g. MS03, AC04, MD01.
reasonCode.title: Reason Code

originatorBic.description: BIC of the institution initiating the R-transaction.
originatorBic.title: Originator BIC

transactionAmount.description: Amount of the R-transaction, usually matching the collection amount.
transactionAmount.title: Transaction Amount

valueDate.description: Date the debtor account was re-credited.
valueDate.title: Value Date

notifiedAt.description: When shillinq received the R-transaction notification.
notifiedAt.title: Notified At

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-007).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a R-Transaction is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

PreNotification.title: Pre-notification
PreNotification.description: A vooraankondiging for a collection. A collection MUST NOT enter a pain.008 batch unless its pre-notification is sent or carried on the invoice line (design D3).

sentAt.description: When the notification was actually sent; null = not yet sent.
sentAt.title: Sent At

noticeDays.description: Calendar days between notification and collection date; default 14.
noticeDays.title: Notice Days

recipientAddress.description: Email, postal address, or invoice reference per channel.
recipientAddress.title: Recipient Address

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-003).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pre-notification is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CustomerMaster.description: Customer master overlay adding the default SEPA mandate link. When a customer has a `defaultMandateId`, the AR billing flow proposes direct-debit collection by default; the field is OPTIONAL — collections may still be scheduled against any mandate the customer holds. Owning fragment: `add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json` (shillinq CustomerMaster is the AR-core analogue of the company-wide `Counterparty` entity referenced in design D1).

defaultMandateId.description: FK to the customer's default SEPA mandate UUID; when set the AR billing flow proposes direct-debit collection by default. Optional — collections may still be scheduled against any active mandate held by the customer. Cleared automatically when the referenced mandate transitions to `cancelled` or `expired`.
defaultMandateId.title: Default Mandate ID

ARInvoice.description: AR invoice overlay adding direct-debit payment-method linkage. When `paymentMethod = direct_debit`, `directDebitMandateId` MUST reference an `active` SepaMandate; the optional `directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId` links back to the invoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification (design D3 / REQ-SDD-003 invoice-line pre-notification channel). Owning fragment: `add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json`.

paymentMethod.description: Expected payment method. When `direct_debit`, `directDebitMandateId` MUST be populated and reference an `active` SepaMandate; collection scheduling is gated on this combination.
paymentMethod.title: Payment Method

directDebitMandateId.description: FK to the SepaMandate UUID under which this invoice is to be collected. Required when `paymentMethod = direct_debit`; ignored otherwise. The mandate MUST be `active` at collection-scheduling time; cancellation or expiry triggers `sdd.mandate.cancelled` / `sdd.mandate.expired`.
directDebitMandateId.title: Direct Debit Mandate ID

directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId.description: Optional FK to the ARInvoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification text for this collection (REQ-SDD-003, design D3 invoice-line channel). When set, this invoice's pre-notification proof is sourced from the linked invoice's issue date + line text; the `PreNotification` register entry references the same invoice via `recipientAddress`.
directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId.title: Direct Debit Pre Notification Invoice ID
